nom: Tatcha: The Rice Polish. Daily Non-Abrasive Exfoliator

avis.titre: So Far, So GoodSo Far, So Good
avis.texte: This exfoliator is very interesting in the way it works. It's like a grainy powder that you dissolve in water and it turns foamy. You then use it for 10-20 seconds, they specifically say 10-20 seconds in the directions. This makes me wonder what happens if you use it for a longer amount of time. lol. I've only used it accordingly, so I'm not sure. I am also not sure as to how this light liquid-y foam is supposed to exfoliate the skin, but I do enjoy the results. I've used it about 5 times and have noticed decent results. Right away after I wash it off I can tell my complexion is brighter and my skin smoother. I don't know how it does this, but it does it. It makes a great short term impression, but I'm going to wait out on the long term results, to see if it was worth the price. I have some faded acne scars that I'm working on, so we'll see how this does with that. The only other exfoliator I've used that has impressed me this much is the freemans charcoal and black sugar mask. That mask is on the opposite price range and has amazing results also, but that's if you don't mind sugar scrubs. Which is a total opposite of this soft foamy exfoliator. The downside to this product is the price. I mean, I looks as expensive as other brands at this price range, but we'll see if it is really worth it. The container is very smooth and pretty. The small purple thing-y protrudes out and is not a sticker, so that in itself tells me they must've put a pretty penny into the design of these c

OMG! What a fabulous product! I’ve been looking for something that would provide phenomenal results and this is it! Anyone that is looking for a great product and for the results a great price this is it! After the very first use, my face feels completely soft and a totally different I’m only disappointed. I didn’t find this product earlier. If you’re looking for something that lives up to the results, this is it…👍🏻

This is non-abrasive. When you put it in your hand and add water you can feel the abrasiveness, but you're suppose to rub it until all the abrasiveness is gone and then wash your face. It leaves my face feeling soft. You don't need a lot, but then again it's your preference. I have 3 other Tacha products to go with the Rice Polish. I love them all. I use them very sparingly because they are expensive.
I have been using this product for years. I receive so many compliments on my skin. I am 56 years old and this product I believe helps keep my aging Skin flawless. So worth the additional cost.
I use this product for around 2 years. It last long because you don't need a lot of it, and it foams really good. It leaves my skin soft and clean :)

Love Love Love this product, got a sample from Sephora and was obsessed with it. A little goes a long way(1.5 yrs and counting still on 1 btl ), crazy thick foam, mild rice sent, great daily exfoliation that feels really clean without feeling dry or tight. Leaves skin so smooth and buttery especially after putting on moisturizer.
This is the most amazing skin product. It comes out as small white grains and when mixed with water becomes a mild, luxurious exfoliating cleanser. My skin feels amazing after I use it.

I use this rice polish religiously. I absolutely love it. Been using it for about three years. Clears up any acne, and I have severe skin sensitivity. Makes your face glow and clean. I then follow up with the tatcha purple face cream. Make your skin look so plump & fresh. Absolutely love, tatcha skin care!

avis.titre: A Game-Changer for My Skincare Routine – Tatcha The Rice Polish!
avis.texte: I had this as a sample years ago and used it sparingly because I wanted it to last, but I never could justify the full-size price—until this recent Prime Day. I am so glad I finally treated myself! A little truly goes a long way, so I know this bottle will last a while. The exfoliation is so gentle, yet effective. It leaves my face feeling fresh, clean, and soft, without that "gunky" feeling I sometimes get from other cleansers. I love that it's non-abrasive and doesn’t strip my skin. Plus, it’s packed with high-quality ingredients like rice bran and green tea, which makes me feel even better about putting it on my skin. The texture is unique, too – it foams up gently when you add water, making it feel like a luxury spa experience. I’ve noticed smoother, brighter skin after just a few uses. Definitely worth the splurge! If you’re looking for a gentle yet effective exfoliator with top-tier ingredients, I highly recommend this product.

This product is amazing. I immediately see and feel the difference after using. I’m currently using once per week and see smoother and brighter results on my face. I’m in love with Tacha products too!

avis.titre: I have never tried anything that feels so soft on my skin !
avis.texte: I originally tried this out as part of a sampler pack. I like it so much I ordered the full size. It feels like rubbing your face with a kittens fur ... it feels so unbelievably soft! Love, love, love it !

The product is fabulous. Delivery is -100% and nonexistent. It never arrived to my home. These people only speak French, which is fine and I only speak English, which is fine. They should learn to follow instructions and leave it at my apartment number which is written the worst Delivery in the world.

I bought the travel size the first time to make sure I liked and loved the polish effect. Bought the full size and top came loose when snapped it open. Product damp and more product in trial size. Is this all you should get? UPDATE: I'm returning the one I got and I received a replacement jar. Container was full this time so I'm happy with my purchase. I do love the product as it a light scrub and good for sensitive skin.
Excellent exfoliation with soft foam and leaves the skin very silky and clean

I love Tatcha’s products and especially this polish. It works great on my combination skin and the grains are the perfect size & texture, leaving it smooth and silky. My only issue is the packaging: with this full size version, I always end up with much more product in my palm than I need. The dispenser hole is just too big. I also have this polish in travel size and there’s no such problem with it. Which is weird, because the size of the hole is identical! Must be because of the overall size & volume of the jar, the small one holds much less product = less pressure when tilted. So I settled on just refilling the travel size from the big jar. Speaking of, it would be great to have an option to just buy a refill and reduce plastic waste. For this product, it’s perfectly doable.

Fake!!! Do not purchase. This is filled with what appears to be dishwashing detergent or borax. The top left small sample on my hand is the authentic, purchased from the company website as well as the container on the left. This product foams up like a soap and smells like detergent!!!! Do NOT buy! I have been using this for years and I can 100% day it is not the correct product. It’s a good fake box and contain but not authentic!!!!
